tests.name: Quick Check
tests.description: Timed check on The Nature of God

questions.question: Q: Explain two Christian beliefs about the nature of God.
questions.correctAnswer: 1) God is omnipotent — Christians believe God is all-powerful and nothing is beyond God's ability, as shown in Genesis where God creates the universe from nothing. 2) God is loving — Christians believe God demonstrates love through sending Jesus to save humanity (John 3:16), showing that God's love is selfless and sacrificial.

questions.question: Q: How does the problem of evil challenge Christian beliefs about God?
questions.correctAnswer: The problem of evil challenges the idea that God is both omnipotent and loving. If God is all-powerful, God could prevent suffering; if God is all-loving, God would want to. The existence of suffering seems to contradict both attributes. Christians respond with the Free Will Defence (evil results from human choice, not God) and the soul-making theodicy (suffering develops moral character).
